Windrose FAQ

Common questions from the Windrose community, answered.

General

What is Windrose?
Windrose is a naval exploration and survival game. You captain your own ship, sail a procedural ocean, gather resources, fight enemies, and explore uncharted islands — solo or with a crew.

Is Windrose multiplayer or solo?
Both! Windrose supports 1–6 players per ship. You can play the full game solo, or crew up with friends for larger ships and harder content.

What platforms is Windrose available on?
Windrose is available on PC (Windows). Console support has not been officially announced.

Is Windrose free to play?
Windrose is a paid game. Check the official store page for current pricing, discounts, and demo availability.

Beginner Questions

How do I get started in Windrose?
You spawn on a starting island with a basic Skiff. Gather wood, craft basic tools, repair your Skiff, then save up to build your first proper ship (the Sloop). Read our Beginner Guide for a full walkthrough.

What is the best starter ship?
The Sloop is universally recommended for beginners. It's fast, manageable solo, has 2 cannon ports, and decent cargo space. Don't stay on the Skiff — upgrade as soon as possible.

How do I save in Windrose?
Windrose saves automatically when you anchor at a Port or major island. There is no manual save button.

Can I lose my ship permanently?
Yes — if your ship sinks in open water and you can't retrieve it, it is lost. Always carry repair kits. Some servers have "soft death" rules that let you recover your ship.

Ships & Builds

What ships are available in Windrose?
Windrose has several ship classes: Skiff (starter), Sloop (2-man), Brigantine (4-man), Galleon (6-man), and special ships unlocked through late-game content.

How do I build a new ship?
Gather the required materials (Wood Planks, Rope, Iron) then visit a Shipwright NPC at any Port island. Select your ship type and confirm. Ships take 1–3 in-game days to build.

What is the best late-game ship?
The Galleon is the largest and most powerful ship, but requires a crew of 4–6 to operate effectively. For solo play, a well-upgraded Sloop remains highly competitive.

Performance & Settings

How do I boost FPS in Windrose?
Turn off Motion Blur, V-Sync, Ambient Occlusion, and Film Grain. Lower Shadow Quality and Water Detail. These changes give the biggest FPS gains on mid-range PCs.

What are the minimum PC specs for Windrose?
Minimum: Intel Core i5-8400, GTX 1060 6GB, 8GB RAM, 20GB storage. Recommended: i7-10700K, RTX 2070, 16GB RAM.

Windrose keeps crashing. How do I fix it?
Common fixes: update GPU drivers, verify game files via the launcher, reduce graphics settings, disable overlays (Discord, Steam), and make sure Windows is up to date.
